title: Senior News Anchor - Amharic/English
description: We're seeking an experienced bilingual News Anchor to present our flagship news programs. You'll anchor prime-time news, conduct interviews with dignitaries, and provide live breaking news coverage.
requirements:
• Bachelor's in Journalism/Communications
• 5+ years anchoring experience
• Fluent in Amharic and English
• Strong on-camera presence
• Ability to work flexible hours

title: Documentary Producer
description: Produce high-quality documentary content about Ethiopian culture, history, and development. Research topics, coordinate filming, and oversee post-production.
requirements:
• Degree in Film/Media Production
• 3+ years documentary experience
• Portfolio of previous work
• Knowledge of Ethiopian history/culture
• Leadership skills

title: Live Broadcast Technician
description: Operate broadcast equipment for live television production. Manage live streaming, audio/video quality, and technical coordination during broadcasts.
requirements:
• Technical diploma in Broadcasting
• 2+ years live production experience
• Knowledge of broadcast equipment
• Ability to work under pressure
• Problem-solving skills
